job.job_description:
What You;ll Do

Design and build full-stack web applications end to end front-end UI, back-end services, APIs, and datalayer
Build and consume well-structured REST (and where relevant GraphQL) APIs, with clean, documentedcontracts
Integrate LLM / AI capabilities into applications calling model provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini,or Azure OpenAI), wiring up retrieval or RAG features, and handling streaming responses, prompts, andstructured outputs
Design and work with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) schemadesign, queries, and performance
Own deployment: containerize with Docker and ship through Git-based CI/CD pipelines to cloudinfrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Write maintainable, tested code and participate in code reviews
Collaborate with product, design, and other engineers, and communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly tonon-technical stakeholders
Take prototypes to production quickly and reliably within the contract window
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG and LLM backend experience, but lacks MERN front-end skills.
